summary: Reading-debt commands expose honest lengths and scope, deterministic rankings, clean duplicate recommendations, and bounded lists with uncapped totals.
reason: These are Readwise-specific novel command policies over the local store; generated scaffolds cannot reconstruct them. Keep all customizations within the preserved command files.
reapply: Preserve unread Reader scope new,later,shortlist unless overridden; unknown lengths have null minutes and length_known=false and are excluded from time fitting unless --include-unknown-length. Backlog priority uses its displayed composite (budget fit, recency, location, unfinished bonus). Read-next uses stable score/location/saved/progress/id ordering and warns for unmatched --prefer. Cap stale lists/dedupe clusters/backlog including budgeted worklists at --limit 50 (0 unlimited), retaining totals and truncation notes. Dedupe ties prefer query-free URLs, shortest normalized URLs, oldest saves, and exclude login/error title keys via the shared deny map in dedupe.go. Declare empty --db-path defaults on the five scoped commands and use novelDBPath at execution; other shared helpers are outside this repair scope. Restore seeded regressions from the companion test files. Read-next prints an array for evaluated results, including agent mode; dry runs use the standard action envelope; hints and unknown length counts go to stderr. Command limit metadata uses limited and limit_note, never MCP envelope field names.
